Type: three-seat reclining sofa
Use: lounging, watching TV; living room, family room
Style: contemporary, modern
Materials: soft fabric upholstery, padded tufted cushions
Colors: warm mocha taupe
Shape: channel-tufted pillow back, plush padded arms, three seats with recliner side lever, low hidden base, bulky and wide
Feel: comfy, cozy, relaxed
Goes with: beige, white walls, grey rugs, light wood; casual family living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand - Solimo Capri Three Seater Fabric Recliner (Mocha)
product.description: Comfortable three-seater recliner with high-quality fabric and an attractive design in mocha color Made with strong and durable seams to ensure longevity. Fabric does not lose color with rubbing Passed durability testing with 100 kg on each seat and backrest for 25,000 cycles; Passed armrest stability testing with 40 kg dynamic loading for 10,000 cycles Meets the European Standard EN 1728 for performance and stringent European Safety Requirement Standard EN 12520 Warranty on manufacturing defects: 3 years Maximum weight load per seat: 160 kg Free from harmful chemicals like formaldehyde, AZO Dye and lead Lightweight recliner for easy shifting
